name: Bilbo, Luckwearer // Burglar's Plot
type_line: Legendary Creature — Halfling Rogue // Sorcery — Adventure

card_faces.name: Bilbo, Luckwearer
card_faces.oracle_text:
Bilbo can't be blocked.
Whenever Bilbo deals combat damage to a player, draw a card, then discard a card.

card_faces.name: Burglar's Plot
card_faces.oracle_text: Exchange control of two target nonland permanents that share a card type. (Then exile this card. You may cast the creature later from exile.)

name: Bilbo, Thief in the Night
oracle_text:
Spells you cast from anywhere other than your hand cost {1} less to cast.
Whenever Bilbo attacks, you may cast an artifact, instant, or sorcery spell from your graveyard. If an instant or sorcery spell cast this way would be put into your graveyard, exile it instead.
flavor_text: "I am an honest burglar, more or less."

name: Riddles in the Dark
oracle_text: Look at the top four cards of your library and separate them into a face-down pile and a face-up pile. An opponent chooses one of the piles. Put that pile into your hand and the other into your graveyard.
flavor_text:
"What have I got in my pocket?"
—Bilbo

name: Smaug the Magnificent
oracle_text:
Flying, haste
Whenever Smaug attacks, he deals damage equal to the number of Treasures you control to any target.
At the beginning of your upkeep, create a Treasure token.
flavor_text: "You think you will get a fair share? If you get off alive, you will be lucky."

name: Thorin, Mountain-king
oracle_text:
Trample
When Thorin enters, attach any number of target Equipment you control to target creature you control. When one or more Equipment become attached to that creature this way, that creature deals damage equal to its power to up to one target creature.

name: Wood Elves
oracle_text: When this creature enters, search your library for a Forest card, put that card onto the battlefield, then shuffle.
flavor_text: After the coming of Humans, the Wood-Elves took ever more and more to the gloaming and the dusk. Still Elves they were and remained—that is, Good People.

name: Tom, Bert, and William
oracle_text:
{1}, Sacrifice another creature: Draw cards equal to the sacrificed creature's power, then discard a card.
When Tom, Bert, and William die, if they were a creature, return them to the battlefield. They're an artifact. (They're no longer a creature.)
